summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of the Big Pivot redesign for Digitrans Global corporate website completed. All 8 corporate pages render correctly with glassmorphism effects, interactive tabs, value hooks, and Global Footer CTA. Navigation dropdown works, login modal opens correctly, and mobile responsive design is functional.
